biography:
Proven track record of site identification, negotiation, acquisition and E2E development of large-scale sites (energy procurement, project management, permitting, state and local regulatory compliance, contract review and drafting, easements, rights-of-way, surface sites and temporary construction areas) in the hyperscale datacenter, utility scale solar, electric distribution and transmission, DOT, and pipeline sectors.

As a Land Acquisition Manager at Microsoft, I coordinate the acquisition and development of Microsoft’s owned, designed and constructed Data Center Infrastructure and facilities in the US and Canada to support Microsoft’s Cloud Operations + Innovation and AI services to scale our business into the future.
